source.section: Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7; record wi_standard_deduction cite: Form 1 Instructions PDF pages 35-37; Publication 106 PDF page 6 Schedule B 7.65% over 431,060

worked: Married filing jointly, 58 and 56, wages 400,000 and 100,000: no standard deduction (the joint column reaches 0 well below this income), taxable income in the 7.65% band. The form uses the Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 44, Section B). Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 400,000.00 + wages (spouse) 100,000.00 = 500,000.00. Federal taxable income = 500,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 468,500.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 500,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 500,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 500,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 500,000.00 - 0.00 = 500,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 37), row 155,169 or more, column Married filing jointly: 0.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 155,169 or more / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0). Line 9 = 500,000.00 - 0.00 = 500,000.00. Line 10a 2 x 700 = 1,400.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 1,400.00. Line 11 taxable income = 500,000.00 - 1,400.00 = 498,600.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule B (joint) as numbers: 3.5% x 19,580.00 = 685.30 + 4.4% x 47,720.00 = 2,099.68 + 5.3% x 363,760.00 = 19,279.28 + 7.65% x 67,540.00 = 5,166.81; total 27,231.07, rounded once to 27,231.07. The Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 44) gives the same before its whole-dollar entry. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 27,231.07.
